description: NaMo₂Mn₂H₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.55 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-68°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.82 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-70°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.82 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four MoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 67°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.20 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.06 Å) and one longer (1.44 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.66 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.98 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) H-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Mo and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Mo and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Mn and two H atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Mn and two H atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Mn atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Mn atom.
